name: ORG-37684
summary: ORG-37684 is a drug developed by Organon, which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 receptor family, including of the serotonin 5-HT2C, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2A receptors, in that order of potency. It has anorectic effects in animal studies and has been researched as a potential weight loss drug for use in humans.

pharmacology.text: ORG-37684 is a drug developed by Organon, which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 receptor family, including of the serotonin 5-HT2C, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2A receptors, in that order of potency.

uses.text: ORG-37684 is a drug developed by Organon, which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 receptor family, including of the serotonin 5-HT2C, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2A receptors, in that order of potency. It has anorectic effects in animal studies and has been researched as a potential weight loss drug for use in humans.

fact.en: It activates all three 5-HT2 receptors but prefers 5-HT2C, the receptor whose activation reduces appetite and which was the target of later weight loss drugs.
fact.zh: 它會活化全部三種 5-HT2 受體，但偏好 5-HT2C，而這個受體的活化會減低食慾，也是後來減肥藥的作用標的。
